info.name: UKK Paket B - Coworking Space API (Smart Space Booking)
info.description:
Dokumentasi & API Collection resmi Uji Kompetensi Keahlian (UKK) RPL 2026/2027 - Paket B:
Aplikasi Reservasi Coworking Space & Workstation (Smart Space Booking).

URL API Resmi: https://learn.smktelkom-mlg.sch.id/coworking/

Mencakup seluruh 50 endpoint persis sesuai dokumen soal UKK Bagian III (halaman 5 - 37):
1. Root & Health Check Service (2 endpoint)
2. Multi-Tenancy Siswa (App Maker) (5 endpoint)
3. Autentikasi Pengguna (Member & Admin Space) (4 endpoint)
4. Space Coworking (Katalog & Ketersediaan) (4 endpoint)
5. Diskon & Promo (Katalog Diskon) (3 endpoint)
6. Reservasi Member (Pemesanan & Histori) (6 endpoint)
7. Profil Lokasi Coworking Space (Panel Admin) (2 endpoint)
8. Manajemen Member / Pelanggan (Panel Admin) (5 endpoint)
9. Manajemen Space Ruangan & Meja (Panel Admin) (5 endpoint)
10. Manajemen Kode Promo & Diskon (Panel Admin) (5 endpoint)
11. Transaksi Reservasi & Check-In/Check-Out (Panel Admin) (4 endpoint)
12. Rekapitulasi Laporan Pendapatan Bulanan (Panel Admin) (2 endpoint)
13. Upload Berkas & Gambar (Media) (3 endpoint)

Fitur Otomatis:
- Auto-save token_maker & makerKey setelah Maker Register/Login
- Auto-save token_member & token_admin setelah User Login/Register
- Variable dinamis untuk space_id, member_id, diskon_id, reservasi_id
- Header x-maker-key otomatis terpasang

variable.description: Base URL API persis sesuai PDF UKK Paket B
App Key siswa hasil registrasi /api/maker/register (Header: x-maker-key)
JWT Bearer Token Pengelola / Admin Coworking Space
